authority: Finite development-release observation with archived native reviews and deterministic integrity/consumer checks. No human gold, wet-lab validation, whole-atlas admission or generalization claim.

run_contract.runtime_scope: Code-only f82 source-requirement clarification and concurrent preparation release; later 4fd13da joint-interface review prompt is a separate experiment, not the prompt evaluated here.

run_contract.input_separation_limit: Frozen source-only inputs, fresh native sessions and code-only runtime are not OS isolation or protection against model training memory.

Include necessary preparation, controls, information attribution and delegated procedural dependencies; distinguish method construction from characterization experiments and biological applications.

scstamp.unknowns_not_resolved: Exact oligo inventory, literal sequence-complete execution and correspondence of droplet amplification/separation stages remain unavailable or unresolved; positive general-description support does not supply them.
scstamp.timing_boundary: Preparation passes overlap; their elapsed times are not additive wall latency.

completed_gate_and_consumer_checks.boundary: These checks establish exact bindings, declared topology, retained qualifiers and reproducible projections. Python does not judge scientific entailment, biochemical compatibility or executable completeness.
